column8: Incredible might has always laid buried within you. Now is the time to rise.
Your home has been threatened. A good man must be roused to war.
A woman can change the world with a single well-placed arrow.
There are venoms and virtues aplenty in the wilds, if you know where to look.
You seek power at any cost... and there is no price too high to pay.
Your search for power took you on a journey inwards.
The rumble of thunder heralds your approach. Woe to those that draw your ire.
The tapestry of time is yours to weave; an element you alone may master.
There's something very wrong with this world... and you're going to fix it.
The more you embrace virtue gems, the more power they offer...
True strength lies within. One must only focus... and believe.
The truth of your faith threatens to break your very soul... but in that struggle lies power beyond belief.
